title: Free object manifest (objects/<id>/object.manifest.json)
description: Machine contract of a free object (governed custom code such as a three.js scene). It declares the props humans can edit without touching code, the objects they can click to edit, the exposed state, the events and their tracking, budgets, accessibility and sandbox. Write it before the code. Derived from the free-scene contract v0.1 of the Elabora research (note 16).

id.description: Must match the folder name objects/<id>/.

version.description: Removing or renaming a prop, state field or event is a major change and needs a value migration.

planRefs.description: Plan objectives and items this object serves (guardrail A1): ids of plan.json, which says what the course teaches.

pedagogicalRole.description: What the learner does with the object. decoration: a decorative object for the course backdrop (theme.backdrop.object): no plan objectives, no events, no keyboard focus, hidden from screen readers.

requires.description: Libraries provided by the host. Code imports them as usual (import * as THREE from 'three'); the build maps the import to the vendored copy.

three.description: three.js r186 (0.186.0), vendored. Allowed addons: loaders/GLTFLoader.js, controls/OrbitControls.js.

language.description: Language of the strings and of the translatable prop defaults (BCP 47). When the course is in another language, its blocks give their own wording (props.strings).

strings.description: Every word the object shows that is not a prop: button labels, status messages, units. The code reads them with ctx.t(key, values); blocks may reword them (props.strings) and translations extract them. ICU message syntax: {name} for a value, {n, plural, one {# orbit} other {# orbits}}, {kind, select, a {…} other {…}}.

description.description: Where it appears and what it means, for translators.

maxLength.description: Room in the layout, in characters.

objects.description: Parts of the object with a stable id (set userData.id in three.js and call host.registerObject). Clicking one in the editor preview opens its props.

selectable.description: The learner can select it (pointer and keyboard).

persistState.description: Save getState() in the learner's suspend data after each declared event, for resume.

maxLength.description: Maximum JSON length of the saved state, counted in the suspend data budget.

events.description: Events the object may emit with host.emit(name, payload). Undeclared events are rejected by the host.

tracking.description: How the host reports this event to the LMS.

responseField.description: Payload field holding the learner response.

correctField.description: Payload boolean field telling whether the response is correct.

score.description: Payload field holding a score between 0 and 1, used when the block is scored.

completion.description: The object is complete when this event is emitted.

assets.description: Files the object loads with host.asset(id). They are copied into the package; no network access is allowed.

file.description: Path relative to the object folder (for example assets/router.glb).

budgets.description: Performance budgets checked by the object test (gate 4). Starting values to calibrate.

a11y.description: description and keyboard are required, except for decorations.

description.description: What is shown, for screen readers.

keyboard.description: How to operate it with the keyboard only.

pausable.description: Motion longer than 5 s can be paused (WCAG 2.2.2).

equivalentActivity.description: Plan item offering the same learning without the object, if any.

enumLabels.description: How each value of the enum reads in the editor, in the manifest's language: { "parefeu": "Pare-feu" }. Keys are values of the enum (numbers written as text); a value without words shows as it is, capitalised. Blocks reword them with props.enumLabels; translations write there.

propsSchema.description: JSON Schema of the editable props (subset: type, properties, required). Every prop has a default and a description; x-* keywords drive the generated editor. A list is a prop of type array with items (simple values, or objects with simple fields) and x-control list.

title.description: Short label of the setting in the editor (default: its name).

description.description: Shown to authors in the course language.

x-group.description: Panel group, for example Content, Animation, Style, Scene, Help.

x-control.description: Editor control. list: a prop of type array, edited as rows (one per item, one field per item field).

x-token.description: Theme token the value comes from by default: a charter token (color.accent) or a custom token of theme.custom (color.blueprint). Colours that carry the course identity bind to one; a material colour (brass, wood) keeps a literal default instead.

x-text-on.description: For a colour the object draws text in: the colour that text is read on, another colour prop of this manifest (paper) or a theme token (color.surface). They must reach 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) with the defaults and with the values of each block.

x-object-id.description: Declared object this prop moves or styles: clicking the object in the preview opens this prop.

x-translatable.description: Text shown to learners: extracted for translation.

x-plan-locked.description: Plan locked text id whose wording this prop must keep.

listItem.description: Items of a list prop (type array): a simple value, or an object (type object) whose fields are simple values. The editor shows a list as rows; a block's values are checked against the items.

title.description: Name of one item in the editor (Voyage, Station).

x-translatable.description: Text shown to learners: extracted for translation.

listObject.description: Items that are objects: their fields (properties) and the fields each item must have (required). A block's item with a field the manifest does not declare is an error.

title.description: Name of one item in the editor (Voyage, Station).

listField.description: A field of the items of a list: a simple value, with a title for the editor.

title.description: Label of the field in the editor.

default.description: Value of the field in a new item.

x-translatable.description: Text shown to learners: extracted for translation.

stateSchema.description: JSON Schema (subset) of getState(). Keep it compact: it may be saved in suspend data.

dataField.description: Supported keywords only: type, enum, minimum, maximum, maxLength, items, maxItems, description.
